inventory.pokeballs_info: These poke balls have different catch rate multipliers and can increase the chance of catching certain pokemon • Regular Ball - Multiplier: x1 • Great Ball - Multiplier: x1.5 • Ultra Ball - Multiplier: x2 • Level Ball - Multiplier: x8 if your pokemon's level is quadruple or more of the wild pokemon, x4 if your pokemon's level is double or more of the wild pokemon, x2 if your pokemon's level is higher than the wild pokemon, x1 otherwise • Fast Ball - Multiplier: x4 if the wild pokemon's base speed is at least 100 (or if it is a magnemite, grimer, or tangela), x1 otherwise • Repeat Ball - Multiplier: x3.5 if you have previously caught the wild pokemon, x1 otherwise • Nest Ball - Multiplier: Works better on low level pokemon, (maximum of x4 for very low level) • Net Ball - Multiplier: x3.5 if the wild pokemon is a water or bug type, x1 otherwise • Quick Ball - Multiplier: x5 if used in the first turn of the battle, x1 otherwise • Master Ball - Multiplier: x255 (100% capture guaranteed) • Safari Ball - Multiplier: x1.5 (only used in the /safari zone)

commands.list:
Catch Pokemon
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• /hunt - hunt for pokemon

Your account info
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• /mystats - check your trainer stats
• /myinventory - check your items
• /mypokemon - show your pokemon
• /myteam - show your active team
• /pokedexall - view your pokedex entries

Reply to another user
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• /challenge - battle another user
• /trade - trade a pokemon
• /give - give Poke Dollars

Use a pokemon name
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• /stats - check stats of a pokemon
• /inspect - check IVs and EVs of a pokemon
• /evolve - evolve a pokemon
• /release - release a pokemon
• /boost - give IV boosts
• /vitamin - give vitamins
• /berry - give berries
• /candy - give rare candies
• /nickname - give a new name
• /pokedex - search pokemon in your pokedex

Other
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• /pokestore - buy or sell items
• /keyitem - info on Mega Stones
• /travel - travel to different regions
• /safari - hunt rare pokemon
• /evtrain - train a specific EV stat
• /event - play the daily event
• /lottery - play the daily lottery
• /referrals - invite friends and get rewards
• /card - customize your trainer card
• /setcolor - set a custom card text color
• /open - show the quick hunt/close shortcuts
• /commands - show this command list
• /song - play the pokemon theme song

Some commands show extra information when you click their buttons.

safari.info: Hunt for rare Pokémon in the Safari Zone Instructions • /travel to the Region where you want to play the Safari Game. • You will be given {balls} Safari Balls (×2 catch rate multiplier) to catch Pokémon with. No other Poké Balls will be allowed. • You will have a {limit} /hunt limit. • You cannot battle any of the wild Pokémon, you must only throw Safari Balls. • You cannot /travel while inside the Safari Zone. • When you run out of Safari Balls, you will automatically be kicked out of the Safari Zone. • When you reach the /hunt limit, you will automatically be kicked out of the Safari Zone. Entry fee: {fee} 💵 /enter to enter the Safari Zone /exit to manually exit the Safari Zone Note: if you choose to exit the Safari Zone, you will not be given a refund, and you cannot keep any Safari Balls. Max 1 play per day, resets at 00:00 UTC. You are not guaranteed to capture a Pokémon in the Safari Zone.
